name: HYDRA-UMC-ORCHESTRATOR
notes: Functional v0: a real mission state machine (src/mission.rs: Pending, Dispatched, InProgress, Completed, Cancelled, Failed, Unknown after an unclean restart; idempotent cancel; node-failure recovery; an attempt number that fences late reports and moves forward on every dispatch and every requeue) kept on disk, served over plain JSON/HTTP (tiny_http, a pool of worker threads) with an optional bearer token. src/job_dispatcher.rs is a real HTTP client for HYDRA-UMC-JOB-DISPATCHER (submit with routing hints, dispatch pass, close by cancelling queued work or completing assigned work, requeue after a lost node) with connect and total timeouts. A mission's terminal outcome is recorded as unconfirmed in the registry and in a durable outbox (src/outbox.rs) before the dispatcher is asked, and retried with backoff. HYDRA-UMC-NODE-HEALING calls POST /nodes/:node/recover. The shared gRPC contract in proto/ is not used by this binary. Contract test against the real dispatcher binary (HYDRA_UMC_JOB_DISPATCHER_BIN).
